name: XauRsiBbScalper

strategy.description: Scalp XAUUSD on M5 when price stretches outside Bollinger Bands and RSI confirms overbought or oversold conditions.
strategy.entry_logic: Buy when price closes below the lower Bollinger Band and RSI is below 30; sell when price closes above the upper band and RSI is above 70.
strategy.exit_logic: Exit at fixed take profit, stop loss, or when price returns to the middle Bollinger Band.
non_goals: Do not trade during high-impact news.
Do not use martingale or grid recovery.

indicators.condition: Price closes outside the outer band then reverts.
RSI overbought above 70 or oversold below 30.

notes: Candidate preset: scalping/netting. Use WebRequest only for a configured news provider; do not hardcode provider keys.
